name: frightful presence
desc:
Each creature of the [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within 120 feet of the [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute.
A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster}'s Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.
Each creature of the [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within 120 feet of the [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.
